meta.name: organic-growth-advisor
meta.description: Identify which organic growth path to pursue — new segments, geographies, channels, or products. Use when diagnosing where a growth constraint lives and which McKinsey growth level to act on next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断该优先开拓哪类增长
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是增长负责人,正纠结下一步该攻哪个方向
copy.tagline_en: Identify your next organic growth path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead growth and need to decide where to focus next.

howto.what: Claude 会用三个引导式问题找出你的增长瓶颈，在增长路径矩阵中定位，再推荐一条路径（新客群、新地区、新渠道或新产品），附理由、诊断问题和首个实验。
howto.when: 当你说增长停滞、不确定该拉哪个杠杆，或觉得新客群、新地区、新渠道等多条路都可行时触发。团队争论增长方向时也可以用它快速定夺。

say.text: 帮我们诊断增长瓶颈：现有产品在美国中端市场增长停滞，是选新客群还是新地区？
say.note: Claude 会用三个问题定位你的情况。

say.text: 我们有好几条增长路径可选，帮我判断先从哪个方向做实验。
say.note: 会把你放进增长路径矩阵再推荐。

say.text: 产品市场契合没问题但增长放缓，该从哪查起？
say.note: 它会先问当前客户和市场背景。

howto.what_en: Claude asks three adaptive questions to locate your growth constraint, maps it on the growth-path matrix, and recommends one path (new segments, geographies, channels, products) with rationale, a diagnostic question, and a first experiment.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say growth is stalling, unsure which lever to pull, or multiple paths (new segments, geographies, channels, etc.) seem viable; also for team debates on growth direction.

say_en.text: Growth is stalling in our US mid-market. Should we go after new segments or new geographies?
say_en.note: Claude starts the 3-question triage and maps your situation.

say_en.text: We have several growth paths open—help me pick which one to test first.
say_en.note: It places you on the matrix and recommends one path.

say_en.text: Product-market fit is strong but growth stalled. Where should we look?
say_en.note: It asks about your core customers and what you've tried.
